explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/548 (the Erdős–Sós conjecture, reported resolved): for n ≥ k+1, every graph on n vertices with at least ((k−1)/2)n + 1 edges contains every tree on k+1 vertices. The Lean statement: for G on Fin n with k+1 ≤ n and ((k−1)/2)·n + 1 ≤ |E(G)| (computed in ℚ, so k = 0 causes no truncation), every tree T on Fin (k+1) is contained in G (IsContained: an injective homomorphism, i.e. a not-necessarily-induced copy). Direct transcription. Faithful.
